issue_text: nodeScoped() (fold.go:358-360) lists TypeLLMCall and TypeDeltaApplied so that Apply (fold.go:53) rejects a node-scoped event whose ev.Node=="" with ReasonNodeScope. But no test ever constructs a TypeLLMCall (or TypeDeltaApplied) event with an empty Node: every llm_call in the suite is built WithNode(...) (fold_test.go:44,55,265-283,472/478,655,932,1087,1105,1123), and the only ReasonNodeScope assertions are for TypeNodeOutput and TypeNeedsInput (fold_test.go:331,335). Deleting the `|| t == TypeLLMCall` clause from nodeScoped leaves every test green (statement coverage is unchanged since the branch is a single OR-return still evaluated on the happy path), yet now a malformed nodeless llm_call folds and persists: after the guard, k=Key("",iter) and the LLMCallData case only checks Index/Tokens, so nothing else requires a node. The TypeDeltaApplied clause is likewise unpinned (though removing it only shifts the error to ReasonDeltaWithoutOutput rather than admitting the event).
